newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian president names interim cabinet.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian president names interim cabinet.

text.p: Bulgarian President Petar Stoyanov named an interim cabinet on Wednesday to govern until after elections in mid-April, a presidency spokeswoman said.

The mayor of Sofia, Stefan Sofianski, was named prime minister. Bulgaria's ambassador to Bonn, Stoyan Stalev, will be foreign minister, and the current deputy finance minister Svetoslav Gavriiski will be finance minister.

The widely respected Sofianski is a member of the opposition Union of Democratic Forces (UDF) and a close associate of Stoyanov. UDF deputy leader Alexander Bozhkov, the first director of Bulgaria's Privatisation Agency, is to be deputy prime minister and minister of industry.
The interim cabinet will take office once parliament has cleared outstanding business.

The parliament began a session on Wednesday to discuss making changes to the electoral law and consider a bill giving the caretaker cabinet powers to conclude loan agreements to alleviate deep economic crisis.

After 30 days of mass anti-government protests, the majority Socialists last week gave up attempts to form a new cabinet and agreed to elections in April, 20 months before the end of their parliamentary mandate.
